The '''Tamra system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Tolonda sector/Legends|Tolonda sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Tamran]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Emperor's Plague" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tamra system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square Q-17.<ref name="EAOC" />
